title: Take and Fork
setup: Black has just pushed a pawn to d5, straight into the path of your bishop on f3.
hint: Removing the piece in the middle of a diagonal opens the rest of it. Check where that road ends.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxd5+}} wins a pawn and lights up two diagonals at once: the check runs to g8, and behind the captured pawn the bishop now sees a8. Black's own bishop and pawns leave only {{Kh8}}, and {{Bxa8}} takes the rook.
